Amara Diallo  
Email: amara.diallo@email.com | Phone: (555) 123-4567 | LinkedIn: linkedin.com/in/amara-diallo | GitHub: github.com/amara-diallo  

Professional Experience  
As a backend engineer at NexCart Technologies, I’ve optimized serverless architectures to reduce latency by 30% while scaling to handle 500k+ daily transactions. My role involves designing REST APIs that integrate with third-party logistics systems, ensuring seamless data flow across microservices. I’ve implemented CI/CD pipelines using GitHub Actions and Terraform, streamlining deployment cycles from hours to minutes. At NexCart, I also spearheaded the migration of PostgreSQL databases to a distributed setup, improving query performance by 25% during peak hours. Prior to joining NexCart, I worked as a software developer intern at TechNova Solutions, where I contributed to building a real-time inventory tracking system using Go and Docker. This project required me to design scalable backend services that handled concurrent user requests without degradation in performance.  

Education  
Earned a Bachelor of Science in Computer Science from the University of Technology in 2022, focusing on distributed systems and cloud infrastructure. My thesis explored the optimization of resource allocation in containerized environments, which directly influenced my approach to deploying applications on AWS.  

Technical Skills  
Specialized in building high-availability backend systems using Go and Python, with a focus on REST API design that prioritizes security and scalability. I’ve automated infrastructure provisioning with Terraform, reducing manual setup time by 40%. My work with AWS includes managing EC2 fleets and setting up monitoring tools like Prometheus for real-time alerting. I’ve also configured Linux servers for production environments, ensuring robustness and compliance with security best practices. Docker is integral to my workflow, enabling rapid deployment of services across development, staging, and production environments. PostgreSQL remains a core component of my database strategy, where I’ve implemented indexing and query optimization techniques to enhance performance.  

Projects  
Developed a real-time analytics dashboard for NexCart’s e-commerce platform, integrating Python-based data processing pipelines with frontend visualization tools. The project involved setting up Docker containers for consistent environments and leveraging AWS Lambda for event-driven data aggregation. Another key project involved refactoring legacy monolithic services into microservices using Go, which required designing RESTful endpoints and ensuring compatibility with existing systems. I also led the implementation of a monitoring dashboard using Grafana, which provided visibility into server metrics and application health.
